sentences.ar: ولاد الحي كانوا يضحكوا على جحا.
sentences.en: The neighbourhood children used to laugh at Juha.

sentences.ar: كانوا يعطوه قرش وقرشين، وهو ياخد الزغير.
sentences.en: They would offer him one coin or two, and he would take the small one.

sentences.ar: واحد قال له: خد الكبير، أحسن!
sentences.en: Someone said to him: take the big one, it is better!

sentences.ar: قال جحا: لو أخدت الكبير، بيبطلوا يلعبوا.
sentences.en: Juha said: if I took the big one, they would stop playing.

sentences.ar: وقتها ما بضل آخذ ولا قرش.
sentences.en: Then I would not get a single coin.
